title: On-canvas drag-to-create-zone + move-zone gesture
guards: --zone-create-gesture-check: synthesizes real mouse NSEvents through canvas.mouseDown/Dragged/Up; one zone created at the drag rect (bypass disproved — comment out gesture recognition → RED assertion 2), zone+tiles move as a group, persistence via a REAL WorkspaceStore disk round-trip (assertion 7, not the prior tautology), + Setup C render-model move path (C1-C3).
iterationNote: Reviewer found 3 defects; builder fixed across 2 iterations — (A) _zoneId(at:) checks render-models + ZoneLayers (assertion 7b), (B) tautological persistence assertion → real disk round-trip, (C) Setup C for the render-model move path. Re-reviewed PASS WITH RISKS.
risks: Render-model move leaves zoneRenderModels stale (it's a let; move updates the chrome .frame + pendingMovedPlacement + persists, but not zoneRenderModels[i].placement) — a relayout before reconstruct could snap chrome back to the old origin. (Visual gate.)

Freshly-created empty zone lands at the 480x320 empty-min, not the marquee rect — a marquee <480px visibly pops wider on release (vs spec 'no jump on landing'). Stored geometry is correct; the pop is a render artifact. (Visual gate.)
Created zone double-represents within a session (live ZoneLayer + on-disk render model); relayout between create and reconstruct unverified (likely benign).
Assertion 11 reads ZoneBoundsConfig.defaultPadding (constant) while the live move uses padding() (resolver) — coincide without an override; latent coupling, low.
needsHuman_visualGate: Create-marquee: live rect tracks cursor smoothly, click-transparent, no flicker; confirm the landing jump (marquee → 480x320 empty-min) reads acceptable.
Move: zone + tiles move as one rigid group, no lag/detach, header stays under cursor.
Render-model move re-render (risk 1): move a group zone, then pan/zoom — chrome must NOT snap back to the old origin.
Z-paint/layering during drag + on settle; marquee ghost paints topmost + tears down cleanly (no residue).
Cursor rects: pointingHand over header, arrow/crosshair over empty canvas; restores cleanly (no stuck closed-hand).
24px threshold feels right; a small accidental drag deselects (does not spawn a tiny zone).
Adaptive snap-back after move (border hugs tiles+padding, no visible pop; header above the tile union).
Overlap allowed (v1): dragging a zone over another just overlaps (no reflow), reads intentional.
Pan/zoom: create + move feel anchored under the cursor at zoom 0.5 / 2.0 and at a non-origin pan.
